prompt: An upstream sync just merged into main. It touched some backend/src/applications/files/ code. Do we need to update anything in our custom v2/v3 UI, and if so what exactly?

assertions.text: Identifies the specific upstream commit (`a2f86e1`) that touched `backend/src/applications/files/`
assertions.rationale: Foundational — investigation should start with the right commits

assertions.text: Correctly classifies the change as an internal refactor with wire contract unchanged (DTO shape, HTTP endpoint, body)
assertions.rationale: The biggest pitfall is misreading a signature change as a breaking change

assertions.text: Verifies frontend callers — specifically mentions the classic `FilesService.downloadFromUrl` wrapper AND the custom-v2 `PersonalComponent.downloadFromUrl` caller
assertions.rationale: Custom-v2 usually calls classic services; correct analysis must trace through

assertions.text: Concludes no custom-UI code patches are required, with concrete reasoning
assertions.rationale: The right answer given the wire contract is unchanged — the model must not invent patches

assertions.text: Flags the new runtime behaviour changes (Content-Length now required, pre-download quota check) as things to verify, with a concrete suggestion (e.g. add i18n key for the new error string)
assertions.rationale: Wire-compatible but not semantically identical — this is the actual value of the investigation
